Deirdre Collis’ = Paddy Gavin’s

I heard this tune played on the radio this morning, played by Billy McComiskey and Liz Carroll. We have been playing it as Paddy Gavin’s. I have it slightly different from their setting. Mine is more flute/concertina friendly. It’s a lovely reel.
